Plan: quantify pairwise relationships and dose support to see shape/saturation clues.
```python
print("correlations:\n", df0.corr(numeric_only=True), "\n")

q = np.quantile(df0["dose"], [0, .01, .05, .1, .25, .5, .75, .9, .95, .99, 1])
print("dose quantiles:", q)

bins = pd.cut(df0["dose"], bins=np.linspace(df0["dose"].min(), df0["dose"].max(), 11), include_lowest=True)
g = df0.groupby(bins).agg(n=("dose","size"), dose_mean=("dose","mean"), outcome_mean=("outcome","mean"), marker_mean=("marker","mean"))
print("\nbinned means:\n", g)
```
